content: HuggingFace Hub rate limits: 3000 resolver requests per 5min window (anonymous), user token raises to 50000/hour. Each model download involves multiple files, chunks, retries, redirects - all count against limit. 429 errors include RateLimit header for retry-after. Large file downloads can stall on corporate firewalls/load balancers silently dropping idle TCP connections. hf_transfer Rust backend recommended for chunk-level resumption on 7B+ models.
